03 / GOOD TO KNOW

A few details.
A lot of possibility.

What aircraft will fit?+

The original KBOX5 specifications describe room for a King Air 200, Pilatus PC-12, CitationJet, or three Cirrus SR-22s. Confirm door clearances and your specific aircraft configuration before making arrangements.

What amenities are included?+

Two private hangars have offices, and three have air-conditioned restrooms. Every hangar measures 65 by 60 feet and has a 60-foot-deep apron.

How can I learn about availability?+

KBOX5 is listed as coming soon. Pricing and availability have not been published. Select Discuss leasing to view Pete’s email address.
